events.title: Grass Cutting Game Demo Is Out Now! 🌱
events.summary: Hello, everyone!The Grass Cutting Game demo is now available to download for free on Steam. Welcome to a little garden that starts with a single patch of grass!Start with a little grass. Grow a lively garden.Harvest plants to earn coins, unlock new plants and skills, and recruit Softling companions with their own special talents.
